notes: The parts database is now pre-populated. Research across the top ~20 HP, Lenovo and Dell laptops of the last 5–6 years — 60 models, 207 part numbers — is loaded into the synced database, every number cross-checked against an OEM/authoritative source AND real eBay listings. Each one shows a confidence percentage (green 80%+, amber 65–79%, with the source behind it); anything that couldn't be corroborated was left out rather than guessed. Batteries are the backbone (corrected several wrong numbers too), plus charge-port types (soldered vs the modular DC-jack cable, with real cable numbers for Dell), keyboards, fans, lids and more. Search any of those 60 models — or hit Find for THIS PC — and it resolves straight to the researched numbers and prices them. Confirm one on a real repair and it becomes 100% 'yours'. It all syncs through GitHub, so every device gets the same database.
